name: Wet meadow
notes: Seasonally saturated grassland without standing water: tufted grasses, rushes and sedges with a tall wildflower layer (meadowsweet, joe-pye weed, marsh marigold) and scattered willow; drawn on European water meadows and Molinia grasslands and the North American sedge meadows.

shrub.name: Meadowsweet
shrub.source: Filipendula ulmaria, meadowsweet, Europe & W Asia, tall herb dominant of damp meadows and ditch sides, 0.8-2 m creamy plumes — Wikipedia / Kew POWO

shrub.name: Joe-pye weed
shrub.source: Eutrochium maculatum, spotted joe-pye weed, northern North America, wet meadows and stream sides, 1-2 m, pink-purple flower domes — USDA Plants / Wikipedia

shrub.name: Grey willow
shrub.source: Salix cinerea, grey willow, Europe & W Asia, scattered scrub on ungrazed wet meadow, 2-6 m — Wikipedia / Kew POWO

ground.name: Tufted hair-grass
ground.source: Deschampsia cespitosa, tufted hair-grass, circumboreal, dominant tussock grass of wet meadows, 0.5-1.5 m airy flower heads — Wikipedia / USDA Plants

ground.name: Soft rush
ground.source: Juncus effusus, soft rush, cosmopolitan, clumps of round green stems in waterlogged pasture and meadow, 0.5-1.5 m — Wikipedia / USDA Plants

ground.name: Purple moor-grass
ground.source: Molinia caerulea, purple moor-grass, Europe & W Asia, tussock dominant of damp acid meadows, 0.4-1.2 m, purple-tinged panicles — Wikipedia / Kew POWO

ground.name: Bluejoint reed grass
ground.source: Calamagrostis canadensis, bluejoint, northern North America, dominant grass of wet meadows and sedge meadows, 0.6-1.5 m — USDA Plants / Wikipedia

ground.name: Marsh marigold
ground.source: Caltha palustris, marsh marigold, circumboreal, wet meadows, springs and ditch edges, 20-50 cm, golden spring flowers — Wikipedia / USDA Plants

ground.name: Common sedge
ground.source: Carex nigra, common sedge, circumboreal, dense low sward in wet meadows and fen margins, 20-60 cm, black-glumed spikes — Wikipedia / Kew POWO

ground.name: Ragged robin
ground.source: Silene flos-cuculi (Lychnis flos-cuculi), ragged robin, Europe & W Asia, damp meadows, 30-80 cm, ragged pink flowers — Wikipedia / Kew POWO
